integrity: Mathematical proof given; reproducibility checker enumerates all assignments only for dimensions two and three, and verifies constructed assignments in dimensions four to seven.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to binary hypercubes of dimension at least four and exactly two colours; no priority guarantee against undiscovered equivalent formulations. Finite tests are corroborative, not an infinite proof.
title: All two-colour strong-majority edge colourings of binary hypercubes
